risks.title: Raw Material Price Fluctuations
risks.summary: Fluctuations in raw material and input prices can materially affect the company's profitability
risks.score_rationale: Scrap steel and other input prices have historically been subject to significant volatility, and the company may not always adjust product prices to recover rapid increases in raw material costs, particularly in the short term and under fixed-price contracts. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Limited Availability of Critical Inputs
risks.summary: Insufficient supply of critical raw materials may impact production capacity and profitability
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on scrap steel, graphite electrodes and other inputs for its steel mill operations and may be unable to secure adequate supply on acceptable terms. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.summary: Increased competition may impact the company's market share and profitability
risks.score_rationale: The company faces competition from larger firms with greater resources, which could impact market share and profitability. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Trade Tariff Risks
risks.summary: High trade tariffs on imported steel and manufactured steel products may impact costs and competitiveness
risks.score_rationale: The Executive Order of February 10, 2025 reinstated 25% tariffs on steel imports effective March 12, 2025, increased to 50% on June 4, 2025 for all countries except the UK, extended to manufactured steel products. (Item 7, MDA)

risks.title: Operational Disruptions
risks.summary: Operational disruptions may impact the company's production and profitability
risks.score_rationale: Operational disruptions, equipment failures or production interruptions may negatively affect production capacity and profitability. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Environmental and Compliance Risks
risks.summary: Environmental regulations may impact operating costs and profitability
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to increasingly stringent environmental regulations that may impact operational costs and profitability. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Macroeconomic Uncertainties
risks.summary: Macroeconomic uncertainties and trade tensions may impact demand and profitability
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks related to macroeconomic uncertainty, financial market volatility, changes in economic conditions and rising trade tensions. (Item 7, MDA)
